CITIZENS’ ADVISORY COMMISSION ON DISABILITIES AGENDA

Kim Vuong, Chair  Marissa Gonzalez, Member

  REVISED

  CITIZENS' ADVISORY COMMISSION ON DISABILITIES IN-PERSON MEETING

  JENNIFER.KUMIYAMA@LONGBEACH.GOV

  COMMENTS MAY ALSO BE PROVIDED IN THE ZOOM MEETING USING THE RAISE HAND
  FUNCTION

  PLEASE DIAL: (213) 338-8477 / MEETING ID: 981 6445 6257
  PASSCODE: 116311
  HTTPS://LONGBEACH-GOV.ZOOM.US/J/98164456257

  PLEASE NOTE THE ZOOM MEETING MAY ENCOUNTER TECHNICAL DISRUPTIONS, BUT IN-
  PERSON ACCESS AND PUBLIC COMMENT WILL CONTINUE TO BE AVAILABLE IN
  ACCORDANCE WITH THE BROWN ACT

  PLEASE VIEW THE MEETING FROM YOUR COMPUTER, TABLET, OR SMARTPHONE
  VIA: HTTPS://LONGBEACH.PRIMEGOV.COM/PUBLIC/PORTAL?FROMIFRAME=TRUE

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  24-54084  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Citizens' Advisory Commission on
  Disabilities meeting of Thursday, June 13, 2024.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  24-54126  Recommendation to receive and file a report on Elevate ‘28 from the Public Works
  Deputy Director, Joshua Hickman.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  24-54087  Recommendation to submit a letter to Mayor and City Council providing updates
  on the Disability Data and Community Survey and request funding to support

  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 1:00 PM

  project in the Fiscal Year 2025 budget.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  24-54088  Recommendation to draft and send a letter to City Manager requesting the City
  Manager assist the Commission in creating a social media campaign to educate
  youth on Disability Disclosure.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  24-54089  Recommendation to discuss and approve the Citizens' Advisory Commission on
  Disabilities 2023 Annual Report.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendaation.

6.  24-54090  Recommendation to receive and file reports from current Ad Hoc Committees,
  including the Disability Data and Community Survey Ad Hoc Committee, Air
  Travelers with Disabilities Panel Discussion 2024 Ad Hoc Committee, Mentor Day
  2024 Ad Hoc Committee, LB Homeless Shelter Tours 2024 Ad Hoc Committee,
  Disability Disclosure Social Media Campaign for Youth 2024 Ad Hoc Committee,
  and Access Mapping Ad Hoc Committee.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

7.  24-54086  Recommendation to consider the establishment of additional Ad Hoc Committees
  and/or dissolution of existing Ad Hoc Committees.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Citizens' Advisory Commission on Disabilities on non-agenda items. Each
speaker is limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Alyssa Campos, City Clerk Specialist, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours
prior to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the Americans
with Disabilities Act, please contact Jennifer Kumiyama at (562) 570-6257
or jennifer.kumiyama@longbeach.gov.
